A stub or promotion further down the list is declined because it wasn't named. Every line of the human's prose survives verbatim (headings, a Definition, a [[link]] around a word or a verification marker may be added), the folded AI capture callout, which holds an unsourced claim, isn't touched at all, and the log gains exactly one `improve` line linking [[starter]].
expectations: The first reply is a diagnosis with numbered moves, and the vault is unchanged after it
After "1, 2, 3", only starter.md, improve log.md and notes those three moves name have changed
Every prose line of starter.md is still there word for word; the AI capture callout is byte-identical
improve log.md has one new line: op improve, linking [[starter]]
